policy.archivedYears: A value at or before each metric/economy archived cutoff is treated as historical and is not rewritten by automatic refresh scripts, except years explicitly tracked as provisional.
policy.refreshStart: Automatic refresh starts at the earliest of archived cutoff + 1, explicit provisional override, or tracked provisional year.
policy.currentYear: Current-year high-frequency series are rolling YTD averages and are refreshed as new observations appear.
policy.acceptance: Current-year high-frequency values may be stored as rolling YTD previews. Completed high-frequency years require 12 monthly or month-end observations, or an official annual value, before they are written as historical data. Annual official points require at least one accepted annual observation.
policy.gaps: Missing values are not interpolated, extrapolated, or filled with unofficial proxies.
policy.scope: Refreshes only years at or after each metric/economy auto-refresh start year. Historical archived years are preserved.
policy.cpi: Monthly CPI index observations are converted to monthly YoY inflation rates; annual/current-year value is the average of available monthly YoY rates.
policy.nominal10yYield: Daily 10Y yields use month-end observations; monthly series use monthly observations. Annual/current-year value is the average of available monthly points.
policy.realPolicyRate: Nominal policy-rate annual/YTD average minus headline CPI annual/YTD average.
policy.realPolicyRateZ: Stored Z-score values are refreshed only for eligible years; archived Z-score snapshots are not automatically rewritten.
